issue.title: Bugfix to Logger and Updates to Backends for new logger variable
issue.body:
## Description

- Merged the `counts` and `probability` log variables into `measurement_outcomes` 
- Added a new function into utilities: `qaoa_wavefunction`. (Similar in logic with `qaoa_proabilities` but outputs the wavefunction instead)
- `measurement_outcomes` is now assigned when `wavefunction`, `expectation`,  `expectation_w_uncertainity` or `get_counts` methods are called for the respective backends.
- Updated unittests for the new changes
- Added unittests that checks the results returned by all the simulator backends are consistent. (i.e. if `optimization_progress` is requested, the `intermediate measurement outcomes` are returned.) (#35)
- Merged changes from `dev` into this branch

issue.title: Result object
issue.body:
A draft PR to improve the way that the result is given back to the end-user.

Changes:
- Solution to the optimisation problem and degeneracy are calculated in training vqa and no longer in the workflows
- Add the hamiltonian representation to the PUBO problem
- Merged the counts and probability log variables into measurement_outcomes
- Added a new function into utilities: qaoa_wavefunction. (Similar in logic with qaoa_proabilities but outputs the wavefunction instead)
- measurement_outcomes is now assigned when wavefunction, expectation, expectation_w_uncertainity or get_counts methods are called for the respective backends.
- Updated unittests for the new changes
- Added unittests that checks the results returned by all the simulator backends are consistent. (i.e. if optimization_progress is requested, the intermediate measurement outcomes are returned.) (https://github.com/entropicalabs/openqaoa/issues/35)
